entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return a helmet. This is absolutely ridiculous, I've been waiting to get this sorted.
I can certainly look into that for you. So I can pull up your account, could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Ugh, fine. The order number is VF88675309. Look, it's simple: I bought it a while ago, but the box is unopened. The color is all wrong and I just want my money back. Are you going to do it or am I going to have to speak to your manager?
Thank you for that information, I have your order pulled up now. I see the helmet was delivered about 79 days ago. Is that correct?

I don't know, maybe! Who keeps track of that? As I said, the box is unopened. It's brand new. Are you telling me you won't take it back? I'll plaster bad reviews all over the internet if you give me the runaround.

Not at all, sir. I was just confirming the details. We definitely want to make sure you have the right gear for your safety, and getting the right color is part of that. According to our policy for standard items like this helmet, you are well within the 90-day return window.
So you'll take it back? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. Since the item is within 90 days of delivery and you're saying the box is unopened, I can approve this return for a full refund right now. I am generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you. Does the email on file still work for you?
Well, yeah. It should have been that easy from the start. Fine. Send the label.

Okay, the email with the return label has just been sent. Simply print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any UPS location. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Finally got it done.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
